tagline: Leading education loan management and servicing provider specializing in federal and private education loans
hero_kpi_rationale: The Floor Income KPI is the Hero because it represents a key element of Navient's business model, enabling the company to generate additional revenue based on interest rates on fixed-rate FFELP consolidated loans.

kpis.name: Floor Income
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated when the borrower's fixed interest rate exceeds the floating rate based on the SAP formula, creating a positive spread
kpis.description: Floor Income represents the additional revenue generated on FFELP consolidated loans when market interest rates fall below the borrower's fixed rate. It is a key element of Navient's profitability.

kpis.name: Private Education Loans
kpis.explanation: Education loans extended to students or their families carrying the full credit risk of the borrower
kpis.description: Private education loans bridge the gap between the cost of higher education and funding from financial aid, federal loans, and personal resources. Navient originates, services, and refinances these loans.
